extracted.name: No Cook Applesauce
extracted.description: This no-cook applesauce recipe uses five simple ingredients and is puréed in a blender, with no cooking required — a recipe the whole family will love.
instruction_lines: Combine apples, brown sugar, water, lemon juice, and cinnamon in a blender; blend until smooth.
